svg.text: Five unique styles · one design system

svg.title: maithresh.sh — Neon Monogram concept
svg.desc: A lowercase m built from two rounded neon arches, terminated by a blinking block cursor. Cyan plasma #38bdf8 with green and amber status LEDs on the #07090e substrate inside a glass tile.

closed by a blinking block cursor.

svg.title: maithresh.sh — Reticle Core concept
svg.desc: A HUD viewfinder: four precision corner brackets and a rotating diamond enclose a pulsing cyan plasma core, triangulated by green and amber satellite nodes. Built from the site's own 14px corner-reticle pattern.

svg.title: maithresh.sh — Glass Prism concept
svg.desc: An isometric glass cube: three translucent faces lit cyan, amber and green with a plasma vertex where they meet. A dimensional take on layered systems and clean architecture.

svg.title: maithresh.sh — Signal Pulse concept
svg.desc: An oscilloscope trace that resolves into a bold M, with a live charge running the wire between green and amber terminals. A telemetry-first mark for a builder whose work is always live.

svg.title: maithresh.sh — Constellation concept
svg.desc: A network of linked nodes with a bright rising trajectory, echoing the contribution graph and open-source collaboration. A data-driven mark that is unique per build.
